verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an integrations page describing 'auditor-vetted native integrations' and mentions Monitors checking connected systems like AWS/Azure/GCP, indicating some integration catalog exists. However, there is no evidence of a documented catalog explicitly covering identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, or ticketing systems, nor any mention of read-only scope controls for these integrations. missing for 10: explicit catalog listing identity/HR/code-hosting/MDM/ticketing integrations, documentation of read-only scope options, and any independent verification of integration breadth.
